card.name: Partway through pharmacokinetic and similar terms
card.fires_on: Responds partway through long pharmacology words such as Pharmacology, pharmacokinetic and nifedipine, and on the word after 'no' in negative statements like 'no pharmacokinetic interaction'.

modes.label: Inside pharmacology words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long technical word such as Pharmac-ology, pharmacokin-etic or nif-ed-ipine.
modes.example: There was no apparent pharmacokin<<etic>> interaction between zaleplon and ibupro

modes.label: Word after a 'no' statement
modes.description: Fires on an adjective or noun following 'no' that is about to name an effect or interaction.
modes.example: Single oral doses up to 16 mg have been studied in human volunteers with no acute<< toxic>> effects reported.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug-science words and in 'no effect' sentences about interactions or toxicity.
